synopsis: EDAG is identified, alongside Bertrandt, as offering autonomous-driving development, simulation and virtual validation services [f8817]. The booklet did not assess either provider in depth, a limitation reiterated in the glossary [f8817, f16106]. Heavy off-road proof for these providers was not found, leaving their suitability for this application unestablished in the corpus rather than demonstrating that they lack the capability [f8818].

relations.note: Both state that EDAG and Bertrandt were not assessed in depth.
